scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @barbearia/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @barbearia/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @barbearia/api && npm run build -w @barbearia/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @barbearia/api
